options.content: Raw measurements are preserved. 24-27 May 2026 includes a known S1/S3 sensor-positioning and NECTOR control-oscillation period before the probes were repositioned.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "wh1_customer")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.entity_id == "wh1_temperature" or r.entity_id == "wh1_probe_s3_temperature" or r.entity_id == "warehouse_cell_min_temperature" or r.entity_id == "warehouse_cell_max_temperature")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "mean")

from(bucket: "wh1_customer")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "binary_sensor.wh1_compressor" or r._measurement == "binary_sensor.wh1_fan" or r._measurement == "binary_sensor.wh1_hot_resistance" or r._measurement == "binary_sensor.wh1_defrost_output" or r._measurement == "binary_sensor.wh1_alarm_relay")
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_measurement"])
  |> yield(name: "states")

from(bucket: "wh1_customer")
  |> range(start: -6h)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "value" and r.entity_id == "wh1_temperature")
  |> last()

from(bucket: "wh1_customer")
  |> range(start: -6h)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "value" and r.entity_id == "wh1_probe_s3_temperature")
  |> last()

from(bucket: "wh1_customer")
  |> range(start: -6h)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "value" and (r.entity_id == "wh1_alarm" or r._measurement == "binary_sensor.wh1_alarm_relay"))
  |> last()
